title: Mathematical analysis of transverse EM field concentration for adjacent obstacles with nonlocal boundary conditions in the quasistatic regime
summary: This paper presents a rigorous mathematical analysis of transverse electromagnetic (EM) field concentration between two adjacent obstacles within the framework of the quasi-static approximation. We investigate three degenerate conductivity models recently introduced in [22], two of these incorporating nonlocal boundary conditions to capture fundamental physical phenomena, such as surface nonlocality and thin-layer interactions.
